This is the official unboxing video for Galaxy Buds On. Meet the first open-ear earbuds in the Galaxy Buds lineup, introducing a fresh way to wear and enjoy your sound 🎵 Designed with an open, clip-on fit, Galaxy Buds On combines lasting comfort, rich audio, and intuitive controls for everyday listening. The 11.3 mm TwinBoost Speaker delivers rich, detailed sound, while advanced voice technology and three microphones in each earbud help keep conversations clear even when background noise picks up 📞 With smart features that respond as you move, speak, and gesture, it’s easy to stay in control with hands-free controls without constantly reaching for your phone 😎✨ Learn more: http://smsng.co/BudsOn_Unboxing_yt

Introducing Galaxy Buds On, Galaxy's first open-ear earbuds.

Enjoy your favorite music while staying connected to your surroundings. From morning runs to busy workdays, Galaxy Buds On moves with you, making every moment feel effortless. With hands-free voice control, Auto Volume to balance music and ambient sound, Private Listening, and Intelligent Clear Call for clearer conversations, you can stay in your music without missing a beat, a conversation, or a moment that matters. One full day, endless possibilities.

Stay Open, Stay On.
